purpose: Build a bounded, image-disjoint natural-image POINT/STOP router pilot from already acquired Open Images images, Localized Narratives captions, and official V6 visual-relationship boxes.
split_source: The pre-existing Open Images manifest assigns each original image atomically to train or development; POINT and STOP variants remain in the same split.
selection: After filtering, choose one subject box per image nearest the frozen preferred area, then select image IDs by seeded SHA256 order within each pre-existing split.

inspect_marked_object.image: source image with the official subject box rendered in red
inspect_marked_object.question: Inspect the object inside the red box. What object category is it? Answer briefly.
inspect_marked_object.target: center patch of the official subject box

describe_global_scene.question: Describe the overall image in one concise sentence.
describe_global_scene.answer: the already admitted Localized Narratives caption

audit.required_review: Primary agent must inspect all 48 marked-image/source-crop cells before any training protocol is allowed.

required_before_training: all 1,728 selected source images match their pre-existing SHA256 values
train and development source image IDs are disjoint
each family contains one marked POINT row and one unaltered STOP row
all four fixed audit sheets pass visual review
a separate protocol pins mixed synthetic replay, trainable parameters, budget, and development gates
claim_boundary: This generation pilot uses official boxes and pre-existing image-level splits, but its broad labels are not exhaustively human-audited and its red-box task is an instrumented grounding task. Passing an audit authorizes only bounded router training, not general VQA, unmarked referring-expression grounding, release, deployment, novelty, or superiority claims.
